Calamitates autem Iudaeorum non tantum Angelis,

page.notes: Page number read as "765" with doubt; the last digit may be a worn figure. Running head restored with V as vowel U ("GRATITUD"), as the printer set it. Marginal reference "Zach.1.12." is doubtful in its final digits. "often-duntur" at the line break is partly blotted and uncertain.
